Gulf America fabricates the highest quality Grade 100 chain slings using Domestic components. These slings are used in Fabrication, Oil Field, Construction, Marine, and Trucking industries. All chain slings are custom made, tagged, and certificates provided. Types of Chain Slings Available Single, two, three, and four leg chain slings Adjustable chain slings using grab hooks or Crosby Eliminator Hooks consist of Shur-loc, clevis sling, grab hooks, and pipe hooks Warning Inspect sling for damage before each use Do not attempt to use sling above rated load and angle upon which it is based Consult sling load chart for capacity reduction due to sling angle or type of hitch used Read and understand these instructions before using sling. Only alloy chain grade 80 or grade 100 should be used for overhead lifting applications Comprehensive Wire Rope, Rigging, Equipment Rentals & Hose ServicesLouisiana's Most Trusted Lifting SolutionsGulf America delivers premier wire rope, slings, rigging, equipment rentals and hose, trusted for excellence in Louisiana's lifting industry.Rigging & ServicesGulf America offers high-quality wire rope, chain, and synthetic slings. Also, in-house load testing, NDT inspections and on-site pad eye pull testing.Rigging EquipmentGulf America delivers top-quality rigging hardware and supplies, offering reliable and safe solutions for industrial rigging and lifting applications across.Rental EquipmentGulf America provides well-maintained rental equipment for industrial projects of all sizes.Hose & SuppliesGulf America is a leader in custom industrial hose, fittings and industrial supplies.Durable Rigging Equipment & HardwareHigh-Quality Rigging Hardware for Safe and Efficient LiftingAt Gulf America, we provide reliable rigging hardware such as chains, shackles, eye bolts, and swivel hoist rings, designed for secure and efficient lifting.ChainAvailable in different grades, chains are used in heavy lifting and securing applications, offering strength and durability for a variety of rigging tasks.Chain HooksChain hooks are designed for attaching a chain to a load or anchor point, offering secure and easy connections in lifting and rigging applications.Eye Bolts & Pad EyesEye bolts and pad eyes are used as anchor points for securing rigging systems. Eye bolts feature a loop for attaching hooks or slings, pad eyes attach to the equipment.HooksHooks are used in rigging to connect various components, such as slings, chains, or hoists, to a load. Available in a range of sizes, including latch hooks, ensuring secure connections during lifting.Master LinksMaster links are used to connect multiple lifting components together in a rigging system, such as chains and slings. Master links provide a central connection point for distributing weight.ShacklesShackles are U-shaped devices with a pin or bolt used to connect rigging components such as chains, slings, and other lifting hardware. Available in various types, including screw pin and bolt types.Snatch BlocksSnatch blocks are pulleys designed for use with cables or ropes in rigging applications. They allow you to change the direction of a line or increase lifting capacity by reducing the load on the hoist.SocketsSockets are used to attach wire ropes to rigging hardware, ensuring secure and efficient transfer of force.Swivel Hoist RingsSwivel hoist rings are designed to rotate, allowing for multi-directional lifting without twisting the lifting device. They offer flexibility and ensure that loads are lifted safely and at the correct angle.SwivelsSwivels allow rigging components to rotate freely without twisting, making them ideal for applications requiring flexibility and movement. They reduce the risk of equipment damage.ThimblesThimbles are used in wire rope rigging to protect the rope from wear and tear. They help maintain the shape of the rope loop, enhancing the longevity and safety of the rigging system.TurnbucklesTurnbuckles are adjustable devices used to tighten or loosen tension in cables or ropes. They provide precise control over the tension of a rigging system, ensuring secure load management.Wire Rope ClipsWire rope clips are used to secure the ends of wire ropes, forming a loop or securing the rope to a rigging system.
